review_candidates.title: Merchant Partnerships & Pilot Operations Manager | Change Wallet | محفظة الفكة
review_candidates.description: Merchant Partnerships & Pilot Operations Manager Change Wallet | محفظة الفكة · by EGYPTENEUR Egypt · Field-based role with regular merchant visits Your first assignment Bring one supermarket or hypermarket chain into a Change Wallet pilot, prepare three branches for launch, and give the retailer the evidence it needs to decide whether to expand. Change Wallet is designed to let customers receive the exact change they’re owed after a cash purchase in an eligible digital wallet. For a retailer, it offers a way to handle shortages of coins and small notes and reconcile each digital payout against a receipt. Your job is to make that experience work during a busy shift and prove it’s worth paying for. What you’ll own Secure the first retail partner. Build a focused pipeline of supermarket and hypermarket chains. Work with commercial, operations, finance, and IT decision-makers to agree on pilot branches, responsibilities, success criteria, and the terms for a potential paid rollout. Measure the checkout problem. Visit stores and observe how often exact change is unavailable, how cashiers resolve it, and how long it takes. Use that baseline to select pilot branches and measure whether digital change improves checkout. Lead branch readiness and launch. Coordinate with store managers, cashiers, EGYPTENEUR’s product team, and payment integration specialists. Make sure cashiers can explain the customer’s choice, check payout status, and follow the agreed cash fallback. Run the pilot in the field. Track whether cashiers offer digital change consistently, how often eligible customers choose it, how quickly payouts are confirmed, and where the process slows down. Own communication with the retailer and follow issues through to resolution. Lead the rollout decision. Work with the retailer’s finance team to assess receipt-level reconciliation, payout costs, and support needs. Present the results and recommend whether to expand, adjust the workflow, or extend the pilot. What you bring Hands-on experience in merchant acquiring, fintech field operations, POS implementation, or multi-branch retail operations . A track record of taking a merchant, retail branch, or payments product from agreement through training, go-live, and early operational support. The ability to negotiate with head office and earn the confidence of the cashiers and store managers who will use the product. Comfort working with checkout data, payout reports, and commercial proposals. You can explain what the numbers mean and what should happen next. Strong communication skills in Arabic and the ability to prepare concise commercial updates in English. Experience with Egyptian supermarket chains, payment providers, or POS vendors is a plus. What success looks like in your first 90 days You secure one written pilot agreement , agree on three branches , and document how each store currently handles shortages of exact change. You identify who owns operations, finance, and escalation on the retailer’s side, and agree what results would justify a paid rollout. Once the payment setup is approved, you take the branches live and deliver the first performance review. How to apply Send your CV to hr@egypteneur.com with a short example of a merchant or retail rollout you personally owned. Tell us what you launched, what went wrong in the first week, and what you did about it . EGYPTENEUR https://www.egypteneur.com/ Explore Change Wallet https://www.egypteneur.com/projects/change-wallet

review_candidates.description: Job Reference 478_26_AII_DM_RE2 Position Software engineer for Data Management (RE2) - CRIS Closing Date Monday, 30 November, 2026 Reference: 478_26_AII_DM_RE2 Job title: Software engineer for Data Management (RE2) - CRIS About BSC The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries. Look At The BSC Experience BSC-CNS YouTube Channel Let's stay connected with BSC Folks! We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured. We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences. If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team. Context And Mission We are looking for a software engineer, or equivalent professional figure, with a proven technical background, and experience in data services deployment in a research institution context, for contributing to develop and deploy the BSC CRIS. Key Duties Build up the BSC research production manager (CRIS) on premise, connected with the institutional data catalogues, research data and software services, project management and governance tools. Develop a software to collect and synchronize the scientific publications and the research results of the researchers of the Center. Develop a modular interactive control panel to monitor the research activity of the center. Connect the BSC CRIS with other relevant external repositories and tools Develop a software module to permit researchers to update and validate their scientific production Create technical documentation and train team members and users support staff. Requirements Education Degree/Master’s degree in software engineering, computer science or related fields. Equivalent education in software design and development and coding skills will be considered. Scientific specialization or background will be considered. Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience Strong knowledge and proven professional experience on databases and data quality checks. Experience on designing developing and deploying backend and frontend high quality modular and scalable software. Experience with software managing research assets, especially data, software and publications. Experience building ETL pipelines. Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience Experience working in a scientific research environment. Experience working in a public center, with basic knowledge of the legal framework for treating with personal and confidential data. Knowledge of a CRIS systems characteristics. Fluency in written and verbal communication in English. Good written and verbal communication skills in Spanish. Competences Ability to work under set deadlines. Ability to work independently and in a team. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and non technical staff. Conditions The position will be located at BSC within the AI Institute We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona Starting date: asap Applications procedure and process All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain: A full CV in English including contact details A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered. Development of the recruitment process The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases: Curriculum Analysis: Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. - 40 points Interview phase: The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. - 60 points. A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position. The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women. In accordance with OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process. The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile. At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment@bsc.es. For more information, please follow this link. Deadline The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted. OTM-R principles for selection processes BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc. BSC-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law. review_candidates.title: Graduate Associate (Software Engineer)
review_candidates.description: Programme start date: July 2027 Do you have a passion for technology? Do you want to make a difference, delivering software used by some of the biggest companies in the world? Do you love working with others in a dynamic agile environment? Our Engineering Graduate Programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and significant career in global financial markets. To be eligible, you must be a class of 2026 graduate or a 4th year bachelors/undergraduate due to complete your degree by June 2027 and studying a Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Electronics/Electrical Engineering. If successful you join a team in our Colombo – Malabe hub. Our Engineering Graduate Programme is a 12-month development opportunity for the Tech Savvy. Fast-track your technical journey, learn and work with our technology gurus, and develop your career in a leading fintech company. Typical duties as a Software Engineer Contribute as a C++ or Java engineer in an agile scrum team. Work towards understand software modules and subsystems from design to quality perspectives With support from senior engineers with translate story-level requirements into tasks and implement them in C++ or Java code. With supervision apply code changes with integrity and standard processes. Gain experience in software quality through unit, component, and end-to-end testing. Highlights of the Graduate Programme Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction 'Engineering Bootcamp' week to immerse you in the business and Engineering principles Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to LSEG Markets division, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework. During the recruitment process we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align to the needs of the business, to allow us to place you in the right team. We will also support you in discovering more about the areas of LSEG by connecting you with the relevant departments so that you can learn more about them. All the while you will be applying your new skills to real world business challenges, through project-based learning. What we are looking for: We are passionate about recruiting people who are interested in pursuing a career as an Engineer and would like to learn about the full breadth of our business – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies. A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions. The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands. People who can collaborate with others, using their communication skills in the process. Understand and an interest in gaining exposure to Backend Software Development Studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Electronics/Electrical Engineering Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the Sri Lanka without restrictions You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it. Recruitment Process: The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume. The second stage is completing Technical and Coding Assessment. The third stage of the application process is an Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG. The fourth stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style. The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite. Please review all the graduate opportunities and make only one application If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only. Career Stage: Associate LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy. Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions. Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance. Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy. Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops. Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject. By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter. If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice. LSEG. Make more possible.
